10.happening: Position {i} is unknown, so it must be solved now.

11.happening: We reuse the cached result for position {i}.

12.happening: We assume position {i} is a dead end for now.

14.happening: The word would end at index {end}.

16.happening: We check whether the prefix at {i} equals '{word}'.

17.happening: The prefix matched — we recurse from index {end}.

18.happening: The remainder is breakable, so position {i} is too.

19.happening: Some word led to a full segmentation from {i}.
19.invariant: found is True only when a split exists.

init.happening: Build the memo and mark the empty suffix breakable.
init.invariant: Only position n is known at first.

recurse.why: A position is breakable if a word leaves a breakable remainder.

loop.why: Any word may be the next segment.

check.happening: Test a cache hit, a fit, a match, or success.
check.why: These decide whether to reuse, skip, recurse, or record.

update.happening: Record a fit or cache a verdict.

return.why: The value flows up the recursion.
return.invariant: The final return is position 0's verdict.
